caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a hand drill or brace, depicted in a realistic style. It consists primarily of two materials: wood and metal. The wooden handle is curved and smooth, featuring two distinct wider grip sections shaped for hand placement, with a darker brown wood grain visible throughout. The top of the object has a round, knob-like handle made from the same wood, attached with a metal collar. The frame of the brace, which runs along the inner edge, is reinforced with a strip of brass or gold-toned metal, fastened in place with several small screws. The metal strip is flush to the wood and follows the object's curved shape. At the lower end, a cylindrical metallic component is attached, which likely serves as the chuck or bit holder, and this part has a greenish tinge. The drawing is rendered with careful attention to the variations in color and shading, capturing the three-dimensional appearance and texture of the materials. There are no additional items or decorative elements present in the image, and the background remains plain with only a faint hint of shadow beneath the object.
title: Bit Brace
